sloka: स तामभ्यवदद्विप्रो वरेप्सुं पुत्रजन्मनि ।पुत्रस्ते भविता देवि महात्मा लोकविश्रुत: ।धार्मिकश्च सुशीलश्च वंशकर्त्ता ऽरिसूदन: ॥ २.११०.१९॥
transliteration: sa tāmabhyavadadvipro varepsuṁ putrajanmani ।putraste bhavitā devi mahātmā lokaviśruta: ।dhārmikaśca suśīlaśca vaṁśakarttā 'risūdana: ॥ 2.110.19॥

translations.english: A descendant of Bhrigu named Chyavana dwelt upon the Himavat mountain; Kalindi approached that sage and paid obeisance, and the brahmin spoke to her who craved a boon for the birth of a son.
